verdict.rationale: Crossplane is an infrastructure control-plane framework, and such a product could plausibly ship a natural-language interface, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes declarative, machine-readable APIs that AI agents can act on, which is an adjacent capability for external agents rather than natural-language operation of Crossplane itself. No documented natural-language command interface exists in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
